new_result.statement: For the uncontaminated one-effective aggregate core M0=diag(a,-b,0)+lambda(x,y,r)(x,y,r)^T, with a,b>=7/8, |lambda|>=41/56, r^2>=27/41 and the third scalar a normalized linear aggregate from a coordinate bank disjoint from the two heavy coordinates, ||p_Q||infinity <=64 sqrt(e)/(3 sqrt(3))<20.307 for every admissible product law.

stress_family.statement: A_m=diag(1,-1,0_m)+J_m/m has nonzero spectrum {1,-1,1}, but every physical principal subset of at most K coordinates has s3<=K/m; retaining third curvature delta requires at least delta*m tail coordinates. The full aggregate remains uniformly controlled, so this is structural evidence, not a QFORM counterexample.

unresolved_implication.statement: Uniformly bound the one-effective branch when the same tail bank also carries diagonal contamination max|D_T|<1/7 and residual R with ||R||op<=1/8. The exact-core theorem covers D_T=R=0; post-rotation conditioning and fictitious independent convolution are forbidden.
